title: Engineer – Pipe System Design
description:
Subsea Flexible Pipe System Design Engineer

At NOV Subsea Production Systems (NOV SPS), part of the Fortune 500 company NOV, we power the industries that power the world. Our core business is engineering, manufacturing, and delivering high-quality flexible pipe systems for offshore oil and gas developments around the globe.

NOV SPS designs and manufactures flexible pipes and innovative subsea solutions for the offshore energy industry. With operations in Denmark (Brøndby and Kalundborg) and Brazil (Rio de Janeiro and Açu Port), we combine advanced engineering expertise with state‑of‑the‑art manufacturing technology to deliver subsea equipment to major oil companies and installation contractors worldwide.

As demand for offshore flexible pipe systems continues to grow, we are looking for talented Pipe System Design Engineers to join our global engineering team in Rio de Janeiro or Açu Port, Brazil.

Your New Role

As part of the Pipe System Design Engineering department, you will play a key role in front‑end project phases, including tenders, FEED studies, and new product development.

You will contribute to concept definition, preliminary design, and early‑stage technical evaluations that directly influence project direction and product innovation. Depending on your background and business needs, you may work with flexible riser system analysis or flexible pipe cross‑section design.

Working in a multidisciplinary and international environment, you will collaborate closely with engineering, manufacturing, project management, and commercial teams to develop robust, fit‑for‑purpose, and cost‑effective subsea solutions—driven by a continuous improvement mindset and a focus on advancing technical boundaries.

Your Responsibilities

  • Contribute to concept development and preliminary design of flexible pipe systems during tendering and FEED phases.
  • Design and analyze subsea flexible pipe systems for offshore applications.
  • Perform structural and hydrodynamic analyses to evaluate system behavior under installation and operational conditions.
  • Assess loading conditions including bending, tension, compression, fatigue, and environmental effects.
  • Support flexible riser configuration design (e.g., free‑hanging, lazy wave) and associated components such as buoyancy modules and bend stiffeners.
  • Contribute to flexible pipe cross‑section design, including material selection, structural capacity, and failure mode evaluation.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, manufacturing, sales, and project management.
  • Participate in technical discussions with clients, installation contractors, and independent verification agencies.
  • Prepare technical documentation, reports, and engineering deliverables.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards such as API Spec 17J and API RP 17B.

About You

At NOV, we are committed to supporting your professional development from day one. We are looking for engineers who are motivated to solve complex challenges and contribute to the evolution of advanced offshore technologies.

To succeed in this role, you typically have:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, Naval Architecture, Civil Engineering, Materials Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Experience in offshore engineering, structural analysis, or subsea systems (experience level may vary).
  • Familiarity with tools such as Orcaflex, finite element analysis software, or similar simulation tools.
  • Experience with Python for engineering analysis, data processing, or automation is considered an advantage.
  • Solid understanding of structural mechanics, hydrodynamics, fatigue, and nonlinear behavior.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international teams.
  • Good communication skills and ability to present technical information clearly.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Why Join NOV SPS?

Flexible pipes are among the most complex engineered products in the offshore industry. Every system we deliver is custom designed to meet the specific operational requirements and environmental conditions of each offshore field — from Brazil to Australia, West Africa, and the North Sea.

Working at NOV SPS offers a unique opportunity to be involved in technically challenging projects that are critical to the global energy supply.

At NOV, you will find:

  • A collaborative and international work environment
  • Opportunities to work on cutting‑edge offshore engineering solutions
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Opportunities for professional growth within a global organization
  • Exposure to both engineering design and manufacturing environments

Occasional travel may be required to support project activities or visit NOV sites and customers. You will also have opportunities to visit our Açu manufacturing facility, where you can see flexible pipe systems being produced and prepared for offshore installation.

  • Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable in a fast‑moving startup environment.

Bonus Points

  • You’ve used tools like Postman, Zendesk, or FullStory to diagnose and resolve issues.
  • You’ve worked in a startup or early‑stage environment and helped shape support processes or playbooks.
  • You have experience supporting non‑technical customers in industrial, logistics, or distribution contexts.
  • You’ve built or refined internal support workflows, macros, or dashboards.

Why Join Canals

  • Real‑world impact: your work improves global supply chains, saving customers time and reducing waste.
  • Strong engineering culture: we invest in quality and documentation to keep moving fast sustainably.
  • Culture of ownership: moving fast while putting quality first.
  • Remote‑first, flexible work environment across North and South America.
  • Stellar product‑market fit with tons of customer love.
  • All‑star team with diverse backgrounds to collaborate with and learn from.

title: Human Rights Manager
description:
Department

Social Responsibility & Education

Location

Brazil

Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Position

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Human Rights Manager working alongside the FIFA Zurich Human Rights and Anti-Discrimination team and reporting to the Head of Sustainability is responsible for supporting the successful development and implementation of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ with a particular focus on human rights-related topics. This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful Tournament through the oversight and implementation of the tournament’s human rights strategy, including the human rights grievance mechanism. As the Tournament draws closer, this role will evolve from planning into operations resulting in an assignment to a competition or non-competition location for the Tournament period.

Key Responsibilities

  • Embed respect for human rights across the tournament organisation and ensure a robust human rights due diligence process in accordance with the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.
  • Develop and implement initiatives in particular in the fields of labour rights and anti-discrimination with a view to ensuring respect for labour rights in supply chains for the event as well as an inclusive tournament experience for everyone.
  • Manage the follow up on grievances associated with the tournament received through FIFA’s human rights grievance mechanisms.
  • Working with multiple other functional areas to embed respect for human rights across their policies, procedures and activities.
  • Coordinating a meaningful engagement process with human rights stakeholders in Brazil.
  • Supporting communications efforts on human rights-related topics.
  • Support the maintenance of an effective sustainability management system for the tournament in line with the requirements of ISO 20121, including the development and implementation of action plans and operational processes, capacity building, stakeholder engagement and communication, monitoring and evaluation of performance, and reporting and knowledge transfer.
  • Work closely with the FIFA Human Rights & Anti-Discrimination Department and the FIFA Sustainability & Environment Department based in Zurich and relevant teams within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Entity to deliver jointly managed projects and activities.
  • Assist the planning and coordination of meetings, workshops and site visits.

Your Profile

  • A deep passion for human rights, driven to leveraging the unique value of mega-sporting events to contribute to sustainable development goals and the promotion of responsible business practices.
  • Deep familiarity with international human rights standards and in particular the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.
  • 5 years of work experience implementing human rights-related programmes.
  • Experience of working in complex, fixed timeline, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Proven track record of generating productive stakeholder relationships that successfully deliver sustainability/social responsibility outcomes.
  • Proficiency in written and verbal English communication.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project) and conducting internet-based research.

Candidate Advantages

  • University degree in social sciences, human rights, political science and/or international relations.
  • In-depth knowledge of social responsibility issues, particularly in the context of mega-sporting events.
  • Familiarity with human rights-related legal requirements in Brazil of relevance to the competition.
  • Familiarity with Corporate Social Responsibility ISO 26000 and / or AA1000 Stakeholder Engagement Standards.
  • Developing and delivering capacity-building programmes and training material for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Sustainability performance management, reporting and communications.
  • Working in sports and/or events; and International work experience.

Unique Knowledge and Skills

  • Quick learner with ability to grasp complex structures, projects and relationships in a short timeframe.
  • Self‑motivated, extremely well organised, proactive and accurate.
  • Strong communication skills (both verbal and written).
  • Strong relationship building and conflict resolution skills.
  • Capacity for interacting with people of diverse cultures and backgrounds.
  • Knowledge of worldwide socio‑political and sustainability issues.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual – Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro until the beginning of the Tournament and to assigned Host City for the Tournament operational period.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Emerging Markets FX Trader with deep expertise in African and/or Latin American currencies to join our global trading & liquidity team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience managing illiquid and restricted FX markets, executing OTC and interbank trades, and designing robust hedging and liquidity frameworks to support high-volume cross-border payment flows. This role requires both strong trading capability and infrastructure expertise, including building and optimizing FX trading systems, hedging engines, and liquidity connectivity with banks, brokers, and OTC counterparties.

Key Responsibilities

FX Trading & Liquidity Management

  • Manage proprietary and flow-driven FX trading positions across Emerging Market currencies , with a focus on African (e.g., NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS) or LATAM (e.g., BRL, MXN, COP, ARS) markets.
  • Source and maintain deep liquidity relationships with banks, brokers, and OTC desks across relevant regions.
  • Execute spot, forwards, NDFs, swaps, and OTC trades to optimize execution quality and manage currency exposure.
  • Monitor market developments, capital controls, and liquidity dynamics across EM FX markets.

Hedging Strategy & Risk Management

  • Design and implement FX hedging strategies to manage corporate or client-driven exposures.
  • Optimize hedging efficiency across multiple liquidity venues including banks, ECNs, OTC desks, and crypto liquidity pools where relevant.
  • Develop models for dynamic hedging, inventory risk management, and spread optimization .
  • Monitor risk limits, PnL, and exposure across currency books.

Trading Infrastructure & Systems

  • Work closely with engineering and product teams to build and enhance FX trading and hedging infrastructure , including:
  • Automated hedging engines
  • Liquidity aggregation systems
  • Smart order routing
  • Pricing and risk management tools
  • Integrate connectivity with banks, ECNs, and liquidity providers via APIs or FIX protocols.
  • Improve execution automation, latency optimization, and real-time exposure monitoring .

Market Development

  • Identify and onboard new liquidity providers and OTC trading partners across emerging markets.
  • Build pricing frameworks for illiquid currency pairs and support new corridor launches.
  • Contribute to the development of scalable FX infrastructure supporting global payments and settlement flows.

Requirements

Experience

  • 5–10+ years of FX trading experience in Emerging Markets.
  • Strong experience trading African or LATAM currencies , such as:
  • Africa: NGN, KES, ZAR, GHS, EGP
  • LATAM: BRL, MXN, COP, CLP, ARS
  • Experience working at:
  • Global banks
  • EM FX trading firms
  • Payment / fintech companies
  • Crypto exchanges or market makers
  • Proven experience executing OTC and institutional-sized FX trades .

Technical Expertise

  • Deep understanding of:

O Hospital Maternidade Maria Amélia Buarque de Hollanda integra a Rede de Atenção materno-infantil e ginecológica no Município do Rio de Janeiro. Suas ações tem por objetivo garantir a integralidade na linha de cuidado, visando a ampliação e qualificação do acesso humanizado das gestantes à assistência hospitalar.   • Garantir o cumprimento de normas e recomendações estabelecidas junto aos serviços de saúde colaborando para o controle de infecção;
  • Ministrar treinamentos quando necessário promovendo atualização contínua à equipe de enfermagem;

  • Conduzir a gestão das notificações de não conformidades de avaliação de eficácia, referentes à Assistência de Enfermagem;

  • Acompanhar a eficácia da escala de serviços da equipe de enfermagem;

  • Observar o cumprimento dos aspectos éticos envolvidos na assistência ao usuário, quando os espaços de atendimento e a realização de procedimentos envolva a participação de estagiários, pesquisadores e/ou residentes;

  • Atender a todos os princípios e critérios de conduta contidos no Manual de Conformidade Administrativa - Políticas e Princípios de Integridade da SPDM;
  • Executar as atribuições determinadas pela Instituição a respeito das práticas a serem tomadas em relação à proteção de dados pessoais - LGPD.
  • Realizar as atividades de área/setor, seguindo as determinações do Gestor imediato e padronizações da Instituição.

Qualificações e Condições

  • Nível superior completo em enfermagem.
  • Registro ativo e regular com anuidade paga no Conselho Regional de Enfermagem (COREN-RJ).
  • Comprovação, por meio de certificado, de especialização na área de atuação.
  • Comprovação de, no mínimo, 6 meses de experiência atuando como enfermeiro na área de atuação (Hemodiálise).
  • Trabalho 100% presencial;
  • Local de trabalho: Centro do Rio;
  • Horário de trabalho: Escala 12x60 ainda a serem definidas.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

Reporting organisationally to the Head of Marketing, Brand and Promotion (FIFA27, Rio de Janeiro) and the Head of Digital Marketing (FIFA HQ, Zurich), the Senior Digital Marketing Manager will be a key member of the FIFA27 Marketing, Brand and Promotion team, and will work in close collaboration with the Digital Marketing team in Zurich and other key individuals responsible for managing, planning and delivering digital marketing campaigns for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

  • Developing, implementing, and managing multi-channel digital marketing strategies that align with business, tournament and marketing and communication objectives, ensuring integration across owned digital channels (website, social media, CRM and mobile apps).

  • Leading alignment with internal functional areas and external stakeholders to ensure cohesive marketing strategies, providing clear communication and expectations across all parties involved.
  • Overseeing the creation, curation, and distribution of engaging digital content that resonates with local and global audiences in support of marketing activity.
  • Ensuring all digital content follows FIFA Women’s World Cup brand guidelines and maintains a consistent tone of voice.
  • Monitoring and analysing the performance of digital campaigns using various analytics tools.
  • Providing regular reports and insights to the global team and other stakeholders.
  • Optimising campaigns based on data-driven insights to improve engagement and conversion rates.
  • Acting as the primary digital marketing liaison between the Zurich-based global team and the Brazilian-based local tournament and event teams.
  • Maintaining strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, ensuring seamless communication and collaboration.
  • Supporting Host Cities and Stadiums, Commercial Partners and Media Partners with tailored digital marketing strategies to enhance local engagement.
  • Staying up to date with the latest digital marketing trends and technologies.

Your Profile

Education & Qualifications

  • Related bachelor’s degree or a similar level of higher education.

Work Experience

  • Proven experience (5-7 years) in managing large-scale digital marketing campaigns, preferably in sports or entertainment and in the South American market.

Additional Skills

  • SEO/SEM Knowledge: Understanding of search engine optimisation and search engine marketing techniques
  • Problem‑Solving: Proactive approach to identifying challenges and finding solutions in a fast‑paced environment
  • Result‑Oriented: Focusing on achieving measurable outcomes and meeting organisational goals
  • Decision Making: Quick to identify issues and make swift decisions in critical situations, taking initiative and assessing risks effectively
  • Strong Communication Skills: Ability to convey ideas clearly and collaborate effectively with team members and stakeholders
  • Fan/Customer‑Centric Mindset: Skilled at understanding fan/customer needs and tailoring marketing strategies accordingly
  • Budget Management: Experience in managing budgets and allocating resources effectively
  • Market Knowledge: Knowledge of Brazilian and South American markets and culture and trends

title: Chief Engineer (Process Safety)
description:
Our Client, a leading oil and gas engineering firm in Singapore, is seeking a highly experienced Chief Engineer (Process Safety) with 22+ years of expertise to join their team. AgileHRO will handle the Singapore Employment Pass sponsorship and relocation for the successful Brazilian candidate.

Important: This role is based in Singapore and requires relocation

Role Description

  • Independently develop/oversee design safety philosophy, HSE Plan, and specifications for fire protection systems (active and passive), HFE, etc.
  • Lead/participate in process hazard reviews and analysis, including HAZOP/HAZID/SIL studies, and be responsible for action close‑outs.
  • Lead/chair the HAZOP/HAZID/SIL workshops, if required.
  • Review third‑party safety studies, including FERA, dispersion analysis, EERA, ESSA, dropped objects study, QRA studies, etc. (not limited to). Capable of independently carrying out similar safety studies, as required.
  • Independently design active and passive fire protection systems and prepare Hazardous/H2S Area Classification documentation, safety and firefighting layouts, escape route and lifesaving equipment layout, and other safety drawings.
  • Carry out safety critical elements performance standards, RAM, fire and gas detection mapping, etc., based on project requirements.
  • Act as Package Engineer, if required, for safety and firefighting equipment.
  • Manage and guide Junior/Senior Engineers and Designers on Concept/FEED/Detailed Engineering projects.
  • Provide health and environmental inputs (including health risk assessments such as chemical exposure, noise and lighting, ergonomics/human factors engineering, environmental impact assessments, etc.) to projects.
  • Interface/coordinate with other engineering disciplines and clients, and take the lead in resolving technical matters related to safety aspects.
  • Deliver project safety deliverables as per the project schedule.
  • Provide inputs and support to projects in all safety aspects, including progress reports.
  • Provide advisory support and oversight to the Process Safety Team for their activities and deliverables and ensure technical integrity and quality.
  • Provide support for new bid proposals, including deliverable lists/manhour estimates, etc.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Chemical Engineering or equivalent from an accredited university.
  • Minimum 22 years of relevant design engineering experience, including as a Technical Advisor.
  • Good HSE engineering experience in the oil and gas industry, in process safety/technical safety, with a minimum of 5-7 years in a lead position on similar projects.
  • Involvement in pre‑Feed, Feed, Detail design projects for offshore (FPSO/platforms) and onshore (refineries, LNG facilities, storage terminals, etc.).
  • Experience in a minimum number of offshore projects (FPSO/platforms).
  • Good knowledge of oil and gas process facilities, local and international process safety codes and standards, and regulatory/marine codes and standards (MODU, SOLAS, DNV/Lloyd's Register).
  • Hands‑on experience in plot plan review, HAZID, HAZOP, SIL classification/verification, and other safety reviews (e.g., SIMOPS, ALARP).
  • Good working knowledge of PIPENET Vision, Flaresim, and other consequence modeling software such as DNV PHAST, etc.
  • Ability to influence designs to achieve optimal HSE outcomes.
  • A team player with leadership potential and proactive inter‑discipline communication skills.

As a Senior Manager, you’re responsible for creating a positive environment of customer interactions that effectively drive achievement of performance goals and business priorities. You help drive your store’s vision and purpose, develop other managers, and support the Store Leader with business strategies and critical decision making. While a Senior Manager leads specific parts of the experience, you also help identify, analyze, and solve complex problems in partnership with Store Leader.

Assist with recruiting, training, developing, and retaining a diverse, high‑performing team.

Maintain and uphold company policies and procedures, and protect all company assets, including confidential business, customer, team member, and financial information.

Perform other tasks as needed.

Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each other’s differences and having the curiosity to learn.

Demonstrate Apple’s values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.

Be a role model for inclusive leadership behaviors and build, develop, and retain diverse teams.

Take action to create a safe, respectful, and inclusive environment for all team members.

  • You should: Be available to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends, and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.

Preferred Qualifications

  • You can: Exceed goals successfully, and persist in accomplishing objectives despite obstacles and setbacks.

  • You can: Manage work through effective organization, planning, and prioritization.

Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes .

OHospital Cardoso Fontes, é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro.   • Preencher adequadamente e de forma legível todos os formulários padronizados pelo serviço manualmente ou de forma digital;

Description

Summary

Senior Manager, Integrated Marketing – Experience Stills (LATAM)

Role Overview

The Senior Manager, Integrated Marketing – Experience (LATAM) is responsible for leading the design, development, and execution of integrated, end-to-end marketing experiences across assigned brands or categories in Latin America.

Operating at the intersection of planning, creativity, media, and execution , this role translates brand and business strategies into coherent consumer and shopper experiences that connect meaningfully across all touchpoints. The Senior Manager plays a critical role in ensuring creative excellence, experience consistency, and strong cross‑functional orchestration—bringing marketing plans to life in ways that drive relevance, conversion, and growth.

This role requires a strategic thinker with creative mindset and strong executional rigor —someone who can turn insights into clear creative challenges, manage complexity, and lead agencies and internal teams to deliver impactful work.

Key Responsibilities

1. Integrated Planning & Consumer Experience

  • Lead the development of end-to-end experience strategies for assigned brands or categories, aligned with broader regional and global direction.
  • Translate business and category objectives into clear creative and experience briefs , grounded in consumer and shopper insights.
  • Design marketing plans around the consumer journey and shopper path , ensuring continuity and effectiveness across touchpoints.
  • Contribute to long‑term experience platforms, while ensuring strong execution of annual and campaign plans.

2. Creative Strategy & Execution

  • Partner with Brand, Category, and Creative Strategy teams to shape creative territories and communication strategies .
  • Develop high‑quality creative briefs and lead agencies through ideation, development, and refinement.
  • Apply creative judgment to challenge, guide, and elevate ideas , ensuring work is on‑brand, culturally relevant, and effective.
  • Ensure consistency of brand storytelling across content, channels, and markets.
  • Support the amplification of Global Core Creative Ideas into relevant LATAM executions.

3. End-to-End Orchestration & Delivery

  • Take ownership of assigned initiatives from planning through execution , ensuring alignment, prioritization, and timely delivery.
  • Orchestrate cross‑functional teams including media, digital, design, consumer & shopper engagement, and commercial partners.
  • Manage agency relationships (creative, media, production), ensuring clarity of scope, quality output, and efficiency.
  • Balance ambition with timelines, budgets, and resources , escalating risks and trade‑offs as needed.
  • Ensure coherence and integration across all consumer connection points.

4. Media, Digital & Performance Orientation

  • Collaborate with media, digital, and DAO teams to ensure plans reflect evolving media behaviors, e‑commerce, and platform dynamics .
  • Support performance tracking, measurement, and learning agendas.
  • Analyze campaign and experience results, translating insights into optimization and future planning inputs .
  • Contribute to improving ROI and effectiveness of integrated marketing investments.

5. Collaboration, Influence & Leadership

  • Act as a key connector between Brand, Category, IMX, E2E, Media, and Commercial teams.
  • Communicate clearly and confidently with senior stakeholders, providing recommendations and rationale.
  • Lead specific workstreams or project teams; mentor junior team members where applicable.
  • Build strong working relationships with bottlers and external partners.

title: Global Networks Leader
description:
Purpose

As the Global Network Operations Leader, you will oversee the comprehensive management and direction of our network operations, ensuring optimal performance and reliability on a global scale. This critical role involves managing a managed service partner to deliver superior network operations and support services.

Main Responsibilities

Oversee the day‑to‑day network operations, including monitoring, maintenance, and incident response, to ensure high availability and performance.

Oversee the escalation process, ensuring timely resolution of critical network issues and minimizing impact on business operations.

Supervise routine maintenance activities, ensuring they are conducted efficiently and effectively to prevent unplanned downtime and extend the life of network assets.

Lead change management processes for network operations, including planning, approval, and implementation of network changes to ensure minimal disruption and adherence to best practices.

Act as the primary liaison with our managed service partner, ensuring they meet or exceed service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs).

Continuously assess and improve network performance, reliability, and security, leveraging data and analytics to drive decision‑making.

Innovation and Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements and technology enhancements, leading initiatives to implement innovative solutions.

Develop and implement risk management strategies to mitigate potential network disruptions and ensure business continuity.

Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, providing regular updates on network performance, issues, and improvements.

Ensure compliance with relevant Orbia infrastructure standards, regulations, and security protocols to protect the organization’s network infrastructure. Take care of regular audits.

Knowledge and experience requiered

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field
  • Language(s) and level of proficiency: English (fluent) and Spanish
  • In‑depth knowledge of network infrastructure technologies, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and network monitoring tools.

title: Automation & Integration Engineer
description:
ContentJet is a Canadian UGC creative agency that connects brands with creators to produce high-performing user-generated content at scale. Our delivery engine runs entirely on AI automation and intelligent integration infrastructure. Every AI agent, content pipeline, and creator workflow we operate depends on rock-solid automation plumbing. Our philosophy is simple: if a human is doing it manually and it’s repetitive, it should be automated. Period.

THE MISSION: BUILD THE INFRASTRUCTURE THAT ELIMINATES MANUAL WORK

Every AI agent and automation at ContentJet needs reliable infrastructure to run. You are the person who builds and maintains that infrastructure — the n8n workflows, API integrations, webhook flows, data pipelines, and server management that keep our AI-powered operations running 24/7 without human babysitting.

Your work directly enables the replacement of manual tasks: when the AI Agent Architect builds a creator sourcing agent, you build the n8n workflow that feeds it data and routes its outputs. When a new content pipeline is designed, you wire up the APIs (ElevenLabs, Creatomate, Metricool, Google Veo) and make sure it runs reliably at scale. When OpenClaw agents need to be deployed and maintained, you handle the infrastructure.

THE ROLE

You are the engine room of ContentJet’s AI operations. Every AI agent we build — whether deployed through OpenClaw, orchestrated via Claude Cowork, or built with Claude Code CLI — needs reliable execution infrastructure. You own the entire execution and integration layer.

You will use Claude Code CLI to rapidly build and debug integration scripts, custom n8n nodes, and data transformation logic. You will leverage Claude Cowork with MCP connectors when orchestrating complex multi-platform data flows that require intelligent routing. You will maintain the OpenClaw gateway infrastructure that keeps our agents accessible across Slack, Telegram, and web.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build and maintain complex n8n workflows that power creator pipelines, content production, outreach automation, and internal operations — replacing manual copy-paste, data entry, and coordination tasks
  • Use Claude Code CLI to rapidly develop custom integration scripts, n8n function nodes, data transformation logic, and debugging tools
  • Support Claude Cowork-orchestrated workflows by building the underlying API connections and data pipelines that MCP connectors rely on
  • Connect and orchestrate APIs: ElevenLabs, Google Veo 3.1, Creatomate, Metricool, Instantly, Apollo, Modash, TikTok, Monday.com, Slack, Google Drive, and more
  • Manage self-hosted infrastructure (n8n on VPS, OpenClaw deployments) — including deployment, updates, credential management, SSL, and troubleshooting
  • Support OpenClaw gateway infrastructure: ensure uptime, manage agent configurations, troubleshoot connectivity and tool availability issues across Slack/Telegram deployments
  • Build webhook-based integrations between AI agents (deployed via OpenClaw or standalone) and external platforms
  • Design error handling, retry logic, dead letter queues, and monitoring for production workflows and agent deployments
  • Optimize existing automation pipelines for speed, cost, and reliability (e.g., finance news video pipeline V7→V8+, creator outreach flows, content publishing automations)
  • Build automated reporting and notification systems that replace manual status updates and check-ins
  • Handle data transformation, formatting, and routing between systems — ensuring clean data flow across the entire automation stack
  • Maintain and improve the infrastructure layer that supports the AI Agent Architect’s deployments
  • Continuously identify integration bottlenecks and manual handoffs that can be automated away

MUST-HAVE SKILLS

  • n8n expertise (self-hosted is a must — not just cloud) — you can build complex multi-branch workflows with error handling, retries, and conditional logic
  • Claude Code CLI proficiency — comfortable using Claude as a coding partner to rapidly build integration scripts, debug issues, and develop custom solutions from the terminal
  • Webhook architecture: designing, securing, and debugging complex webhook flows across multiple platforms
  • Basic Linux/VPS administration: SSH, systemd, file management, logs, cron jobs, process monitoring
  • Experience with Docker (containerized deployments, docker-compose) — critical for managing OpenClaw and self-hosted services
  • Database basics: SQLite, PostgreSQL — enough to troubleshoot persistence issues, run queries, and manage credential stores
  • Understanding of MCP (Model Context Protocol) — how Claude Cowork connects to external tools and how to build/maintain those connections

NICE-TO-HAVE

  • Experience with Claude Cowork and MCP connector workflows
  • Experience deploying and managing OpenClaw or similar AI agent gateways in production
  • Experience with Make (Integromat) or Zapier in addition to n8n
  • Familiarity with video/audio APIs: ElevenLabs, Creatomate, HeyGen, Google Veo 3.1
  • Experience with email automation platforms (Instantly, Smartlead, Lemlist)
  • Knowledge of CI/CD, monitoring tools (Uptime Kuma, Grafana), or logging stacks
  • Familiarity with Slack API, Monday.com API, Telegram Bot API, or similar workspace/platform tools
  • Background in UGC, creator operations, or content production workflows
  • French or Arabic language skills

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Within 30 days: You’ve audited and stabilized our existing n8n workflows, VPS infrastructure, and OpenClaw deployment, fixing known issues. You’re using Claude Code CLI daily to debug and ship fixes fast.

Within 60 days: You’re independently building new automation workflows for client and creator projects using n8n and Claude Code CLI. You’ve implemented monitoring for our OpenClaw gateway and critical production workflows. At least 5 manual processes have been replaced with automated pipelines.

Within 90 days: You’re managing 10+ concurrent production workflows, our infrastructure runs at 99%+ uptime, and you’re the go-to person for all integration, deployment, and infrastructure work. Manual data handling and coordination tasks are effectively eliminated from ContentJet’s daily operations.

title: Técnico(a) de Enfermagem
description:
Como é ser uma pessoa técnica de enfermagem no projeto de MSF?

Como Técnico(a) de Enfermagem no projeto de TB, você atuará diretamente no cuidado a pacientes privados de liberdade, colaborando com as equipes médicas e de enfermagem para garantir um atendimento seguro, humanizado e alinhado aos protocolos do Ministério da Saúde e da MSF.

Sua atuação é fundamental para o diagnóstico, tratamento e monitoramento da tuberculose, contribuindo para a qualidade da assistência, a continuidade do cuidado e a redução da transmissão dentro das unidades prisionais.

Quais serão seus desafios?

  1. Cuidados Diretos ao Paciente
    • Executar cuidados de enfermagem conforme prescrição médica e de enfermagem, seguindo protocolos institucionais e do Ministério da Saúde.
    • Administrar medicamentos e realizar controle de sinais vitais, mantendo registros adequados em prontuário.
    • Auxiliar na coleta de amostras biológicas e na preparação de pacientes para exames e procedimentos.
    • Acompanhar pacientes durante consultas e exames, garantindo segurança e conforto.
  2. Apoio às Atividades de Diagnóstico e Tratamento da TB
    • Apoiar triagens, coleta de escarro e acompanhamento de pacientes em tratamento, conforme fluxos estabelecidos.
    • Monitorar a adesão ao tratamento e reportar intercorrências ao(a) Enfermeiro(a) Supervisor(a).
    • Participar de campanhas e atividades de rastreamento ativo de casos de TB nas unidades prisionais.
  3. Controle de Infecção e Biossegurança
    • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de biossegurança e o uso adequado de EPIs.
    • Garantir a desinfecção correta dos ambientes e dos materiais utilizados.
    • Notificar imediatamente qualquer exposição a risco biológico, conforme protocolos vigentes.
  4. Apoio à Gestão de Medicamentos e Materiais
    • Apoiar o(a) Supervisor(a) de Farmácia no controle de estoque e no uso racional de medicamentos e insumos.
    • Zelar pela conservação de materiais e equipamentos, reportando necessidades de reposição ou manutenção.
  5. Registro e Relatórios
    • Assegurar o preenchimento correto de prontuários, fichas e instrumentos de registro.
    • Contribuir para a coleta e consolidação de dados utilizados nos relatórios mensais e nos indicadores do projeto.

Como é o dia a dia da posição?

  • Realizar atendimentos de enfermagem a pacientes privados de liberdade.
  • Executar atividades de triagem clínica, coleta de exames e apoio às consultas médicas.
  • Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares no acompanhamento de casos.
  • Acompanhar fluxos de diagnóstico e tratamento da TB dentro das unidades prisionais.
  • Manter registros atualizados e garantir comunicação eficiente com a supervisão.
  • Aplicar rigorosamente práticas de biossegurança e controle de infecção.

Requisitos

  • Formação completa em Técnico(a) de Enfermagem.
  • Registro profissional ativo no COREN.
  • Conhecimento dos protocolos do SUS e das normas de biossegurança.

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery. What It’s Like to Work at YipitData: YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData: Ownership That Matters : You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth : We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles : Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for. About The Role: The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs. Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale. As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will: Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics. Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs. Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time. Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale. Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows. Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy. Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances. description: At Drip, we believe the world needs independent retail. Thousands of ecommerce brands all over the globe trust Drip to build engaging and profitable relationships with their customers. We've worked hard to build an awesome company culture based on our 5 Guiding Principles that are more than just words on a wall (learn more: ). Ready to empower the rebellion? Assist users in resolving technical problems with applications, computer systems, and network devices. Documentation & Reporting Create and update technical documentation, user guides, and FAQs. Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, resolutions, and troubleshooting processes. Escalation Management Work with the Escalations Team to escalate complex issues when first-line troubleshooting does not resolve the problem. Collaborate with other departments (Product, Engineering, Success) to ensure comprehensive issue resolution.Skills & Qualifications:Technical Expertise: Proficiency in operating systems (Windows, macOS, Linux) and common software applications. Strong understanding of network configurations, protocols (TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP), and hardware components. Familiarity with ticketing systems and remote troubleshooting tools. Technically inclined with the ability to understand and work with APIs, integrations, and data flows between systems. Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.G., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams. Curious and adaptable, with a desire to learn new tools, technologies, and platforms quickly. Problem-solving Ability: An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly. Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users. Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction. Organizational Skills: Detail-oriented, with strong documentation and record-keeping abilities. Ability to prioritize tasks and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.Preferred Experience:Previous experience in a help desk, IT support, or technical support role. Knowledge of cloud-based services (e.G., AWS, Azure) and virtualization technologies. Experience with troubleshooting mobile devices (Android, iOS). Familiarity with APIs, integrations, or automation concepts (hands-on experience a plus, but not required). Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams. Previous work with an American company Education & Certifications:Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required. Equivalent experience gained through professional work, certifications, technical training programs, or self-study is highly valued. Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.Who You Are: A solid technical aptitude- we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth. You're an empathetic self-starter who loves technology and enjoys helping others to successfully use it - this isn't run-of-the-mill customer service, we strive for the Melt Your Face experience! We represent the human side of Drip Passion for helping others internally and externally Impeccable written and verbal communication and strong attention to detail In addition, we give bonus points for having a SaaS or Ecommerce background!

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala. Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos. Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar edisponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelasDelta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança dedados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções depipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz epropor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiar validações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar comanalistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas. Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático de Python para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial com Databricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridadecom pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade deinvestigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado. Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Senior Devops Engineer (Kubernetes & Cloud Infrastructure) Pj

The ideal candidate brings deep VMware and Azure experience, strong production support capabilities, and the ability to work across infrastructure, cloud, and networking domains in a collaborative, hybrid-specialist team.Roles and Responsibilities- Manage and optimize a large VMware environment across multiple physical hosts.- Support migration initiatives from on-premises VMware infrastructure to Microsoft Azure.- Design and implement cloud-based solutions in Azure, ensuring scalability, security, and high availability.- Build and maintain disaster recovery strategies across on-premises and cloud environments.- Administer and support VMware platforms, including vCenter, vSAN, and related virtualization components.- Support and manage Microsoft 365 (O365) services within the broader infrastructure ecosystem.- Monitor system performance and troubleshoot infrastructure issues across virtualized, cloud, and network layers.- Support networking components including firewalls, routing, switching, VPNs, and secure access solutions.- Work with security platforms such as Zscaler and contribute to overall infrastructure security posture.- Participate in modernization projects aimed at improving system performance, scalability, and operational efficiency.- Collaborate with cross-functional IT and security teams to align infrastructure with business needs.- Maintain accurate title: Web Content Editor / Web Qa (Growth Role)
description: Location: Brazil Team: Digital / Web Company Description Bucksense, Inc. is a company dedicated to bridging the gap between brands and publishers by fostering an open and trustworthy environment. We leverage creativity, skilled professionals, and advanced technology to drive marketing performance across multiple channels. Our services for brands empower businesses to take control of their digital marketing strategies, data, and outcomes, while our DirectoPub platform offers publishers innovative opportunities to optimize revenue. At Bucksense, we combine technology with human expertise to provide a unified platform for managing marketing operations effectively. Our mission is to deliver impactful results with efficiency and clarity. Role Overview We are seeking a digitally savvy, detail-oriented Web Content Editor with a strong interest in web quality assurance and UX excellence. This role sits at the intersection of editorial, web publishing, and QA, and is ideal for a mid-level professional who wants to grow into a QA leadership role over time. You will be responsible for ensuring that all web content across our travel portals is clear, accurate, consistent, accessible, and presented to a high standard, while also progressively taking ownership of content-related QA processes and cross-team quality checks. You will collaborate closely with content creators, designers, developers, and marketing teams to ensure a polished, high-quality web experience. Key Responsibilities: Content Editing & Publishing Edit, proofread, and publish web content to ensure clarity, accuracy, grammar, and alignment with brand guidelines. Maintain consistency in tone, style, formatting, and structure across pages. Manage and update content within a CMS (e.G., Sanity, WordPress, or similar). Coordinate content updates with writers, designers, developers, and stakeholders. Maintain an editorial calendar and oversee timely content updates. UX, Accessibility & Content Quality Review content presentation across devices to ensure usability, readability, and mobile optimization. Ensure accessibility best practices are followed (e.G., alt text, content structure, readability). Apply UX and SEO best practices, including internal linking and content optimization. Assess image quality, typography, layout, and overall visual presentation. Web QA & Quality Ownership Perform content-focused QA checks to ensure pages are published correctly and meet quality standards. Identify and flag content-related issues such as broken links, formatting errors, incorrect displays, or inconsistencies. Collaborate with developers and designers to resolve quality issues. Contribute to the development of QA standards, checklists, and processes related to web content. Gradually take increased ownership of web quality assurance as part of a long-term growth path toward QA leadership. Performance & Optimization Monitor website performance and user engagement using analytics tools (e.G., Google Analytics). Conduct regular content audits to identify outdated, underperforming, or improvement-ready content. Recommend enhancements based on data and qualitative review. Qualifications & Skills 2+ years of experience in digital content editing, web publishing, or content operations. Strong editorial skills: writing, editing, and proofreading with exceptional attention to detail. Hands-on experience working with CMS platforms (Sanity, WordPress, or headless CMS). Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for light formatting and layout adjustments. Solid understanding of UX principles, accessibility, and mobile-first web best practices. Comfort reviewing web pages for quality, consistency, and presentation issues. Experience using analytics tools to assess content performance. Organized, proactive, and comfortable managing multiple content workflows. Interest in growing into a broader QA-focused role over time. Nice to Have Prior exposure to web QA, content QA, or digital quality processes. Experience in travel, lifestyle, luxury, or e-commerce environments. Familiarity with structured QA documentation or checklists. Growth Opportunity This role is designed to evolve over time, with the opportunity to grow into a lead QA role for web content and digital experience, helping define standards and processes across our platforms.

title: Veterinary Radiologist
description: Veterinary Radiologist - Remote About SignalPET SignalPET is a pioneering technology company reshaping veterinary medicine through AI-powered radiograph interpretation. Our mission is to provide fast, accurate, and accessible diagnostic insights to veterinarians around the world. Role Overview We are seeking experienced Veterinary Radiologists based in Brazil to join us. In this 100% remote role, you will review AI-assisted radiographic studies, validate findings, and support clinical quality initiatives. This is a unique chance to combine your clinical expertise with innovative technology on a global scale. Key Responsibilities Review and interpret routine small-animal radiographic studies. Validate the accuracy of AI-generated reports. Provide expert insights and feedback on reported cases. Collaborate with veterinarians and fellow radiologists worldwide. Participate in quality control and system enhancement projects. Stay informed on developments in diagnostic imaging and veterinary AI. Qualifications Médico Veterinário with specialization in Diagnóstico por Imagem or Radiologia Veterinária. M.V., MSc or M.V., PhD preferred. 5+ years of experience in small animal diagnostic imaging. What We Offer Fully remote role (Brazil-based). Supportive, international team and culture. Full training provided—no prior AI experience required. A meaningful opportunity to shape the future of veterinary diagnostics. *** IMPORTANT NOTICE *** This role has had to be re-advertised due to candidates not responding to LinkedIn messages sent to arrange interviews. Please ensure that you check your LinkedIn messages daily and respond promptly. Failure to respond may result in your application not being considered further. We appreciate your cooperation and look forward to hearing from responsive candidates.

title: Analista De Crédito | High Grade / Large Corporate
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo? Então essa é a sua chance! Buscamos: Analista de P&D - Golang/C++ Resumo do Propósito da Função: Esta função oferece uma empolgante posição de desenvolvimento de software na equipe de Engenharia, uma organização multicultural com times baseados na Europa e na América do Sul, responsável por pesquisar e desenvolver soluções de hardware e software para sistemas de medição de audiência utilizados globalmente. Este profissional fará parte da equipe responsável pelos sistemas de correspondência de áudio desenvolvidos pelo IBOPE, que estão sendo implementados em diversos países. Esse sistema compara áudios coletados por dispositivos de medição dedicados com uma biblioteca de conteúdos de TV, utilizando a tecnologia proprietária de correspondência de áudio do IBOPE (técnica de fingerprinting). O IBOPE possui sistemas desenvolvidos tanto para ambientes on-premises quanto em nuvem, utilizando uma abordagem agnóstica de cloud. Sua arquitetura é composta por diversas tecnologias de ponta, como containers, Kubernetes, entre outras. Esta função envolve: Manutenção de tecnologias existentes baseadas em Linux para ambientes on-premises. Pesquisa, criação e desenvolvimento de aplicações — baseadas em charts do Kubernetes e/ou disponíveis na CNCF (Cloud Native Computing Foundation) — responsáveis por comunicação, busca otimizada em grandes volumes de dados, armazenamento de dados e mais, utilizando tecnologias e técnicas avançadas. Manutenção de pipelines. Melhoria do código por meio da adição de ferramentas para avaliação da qualidade do código. RESPONSABILIDADES: Manter tecnologias existentes implantadas em vários países. Implementar novas tecnologias para sistemas de medição de audiência com base em tecnologias existentes e novas. Pesquisar novas tecnologias para aprimorar o produto. Desenvolver novos serviços. Criar novos charts do Kubernetes. Garantir a comunicação dos containers Kubernetes dentro e fora dos clusters. Manter a tecnologia atual. REQUISITOS: Essencial: Superior completo ou cursando último ano na área de tecnologia. Experiência com Linux / bash scripting. Sólidos conhecimentos em C++ and/or Golang TDD – metodologia de testes Experiência com SQL database e NoSQL database. Inglês avançado para conversas técnicas e documentação. Desejável: Javascript Kubernetes AKS Terraform Monitoring systems Prometheus Stack Messaging (RabbitMQ) O que oferecemos? Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade: Vale Refeição e Alimentação Horário Flexível Modelo de trabalho remoto Assistência Médica e Odontológica Convênio Farmácia Participação nos Lucros e Resultados Previdência Privada Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos Convênio com empresas parceiras Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe;
Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valorizamos talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você! No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Senior Content Manager

And today, the data we extract helps thousands of organizations make smarter business decisions, secure competitive advantage, and drive sustainable growth. We need to see this in your mentality.- Campaign Writing Aficionado: You know what it takes to take a great piece of content and ensure our target audiences see it and appreciate it. This includes the ability to repurpose, identify alternative formats (video, infographics, podcast episode, etc.), and amplify the core messages.- Fast-Moving: You value execution speed and iteration over perfect briefs.Requirements- 5+ years B2B SaaS marketing, ideally with developer or technical products- Strong copywriting + AI-assisted content skills- Track record of fast, iterative campaign launches across channels, with a strong working knowledge of channel nuances.- (BONUS) Familiarity with web scraping, data extraction, or developer toolsTech You’ll work with- HubSpot, Microsoft Clarity, Google Analytics- Figma, Notion, Google Workspace- ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other LLMs for message generation and ideationHow We WorkWe move fast, learn loud, and optimize often. You’ll have the autonomy to test, iterate, and scale ideas that work.As a new Zytan, you will:Become part of a self-motivated, progressive, multi-cultural team.Have the freedom and flexibility to work from where you do your best work.Attend conferences and meet with team members from across the globe.Work with cutting-edge open source technologies and tools.#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: English Teacher
description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone. If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach! Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week. What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire? You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts. If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out. When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month. Minimum Requirements: Portuguese as a first language. C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection. Must pass a criminal background check. Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability. Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

transparent cryptocurrency derivatives platforms in the space.Key Responsibilities- Oversee daily liquidity positioning in both BRL and digital assets, ensuring the firm meets all operational and Garantir aderência a controles de Copilot Studio (ex.: data policies, autenticação, conectores/ações, roteamento de ambientes, logs e rastreabilidade). 3) Desenvolvimento e Troubleshooting (N3 Maker) — obrigatório Desenvolver e dar suporte avançado (N3) em:Agentes no Copilot Studio (conectores, knowledge sources, autenticação, governança de publicação e segurança). Power Apps (Canvas e/ou Model-driven conforme necessidade) e Power Automate (cloud flows, integrações e automações administrativas). Diagnosticar incidentes complexos de makers/ambientes (erros de permissão, conectores, falhas de execução, limites/capacidade, problemas de DLP e ALM). 4) Administração do Dataverse (capacidade, saúde e KPIs) Administrar o Dataverse garantindo utilização dentro de KPIs (capacidade, performance, organização e governança do inventário). Monitorar e corrigir causas de degradação (crescimento descontrolado, ambientes mal configurados, automações etc.). Apoiar governança de dados/entidades relevantes ao CoE e relatórios operacionais. 5) Gestão de custos e sustentabilidade financeira Controlar e reportar custos e consumo de:Power Apps / Power Automate Copilot Studio (agentes) Propor medidas de otimização (racionalização de ambientes, consolidação/arquivamento, revisão de owners/licenças, desativação de ativos sem uso, melhoria de governança de conectores) 6) Operação do CoE (Power Platform + Copilot Studio) Administrar e evoluir o Centro de Excelência (CoE): inventário, auditoria operacional, padrões, dashboards e rotinas automatizadas de governança. Monitorar automações administrativas do CoE e garantirexecução/observabilidade. Suportar a organização com orientações de governança e boas práticas (makers, owners, champions e times low-code). 7) SharePoint Online (governança e sustentação) Atuar em governança de SharePoint Online (estrutura, acessos, padrões de armazenamento, higiene/organização e integração com soluções Power Platform/Copilot) Requisitos obrigatórios Experiência prática com administração e governança do Power Platform (ambientes, DLP, conectores, capacidade, troubleshooting). Conhecimento sólido de licenciamento e segurança no ecossistema Power Platform + M365. Capacidade de desenvolver:Agentes no Copilot Studio (incluindo conectores/ações e governança) Power Apps e Power Automate (para ser N3 de desenvolvimento e plataforma) Vivência com Dataverse (administração, organização e sustentação operacional). Experiência com SharePoint Online (admin/governança básica a intermediária e integrações). Diferenciais (nice to have) Experiência com CoE Starter Kit e práticas de adoção/governança em escala. Conhecimento de logs/auditoria (Purview/Sentinel) aplicados a Copilot Studio e governança. Noções de ALM / padrões / RACI para governança e operação de plataformas low-code. title: Senior Software Engineering Manager
description: About the Job As Silicon Valley Consulting we help companies improve their ads by building custom martech solutions. You'll be working for Silicon Valley Consulting's child company TGA Fund. ( TGA Fund is a high-ownership venture builder studio that invests in startups and creates new startups in-house. We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineering Manager to join our team! This is not a generic engineering management role. We need an engineer, first who is a hands on platform leader, reliable and decisive, with great communication skills. This is a high-ownership role where you’ll lead critical platform initiatives, scale high-performing teams, and shape the technical foundations of upcoming projects/products. You'll get to manage multiple SaaS products via the engineering team that you'll lead. You also get revenue share from the products you'll manage via the engineering team.
